rebuttals.argument: We are continuing our geo-fenced digital campaigns to promote Order Ahead, and we're excited to launch a loyalty incentive for repeat users. Increasing peak staffing in our 12 shops is a crucial step to ensure we can absorb the incremental demand, especially from those Starbucks customers looking for a more reliable morning option, while protecting our service proposition. This aligns with our strategy to build durable repeat business.
